news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year Over Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: NeurAxis posted Q2 2026 revenue of $1.93M, up 116% year-over-year on Category I CPT code-driven reimbursement gains, with gross margin near 86%, but a wider-than-expected net loss of $0.19/share (vs. $0.16 consensus) sent shares down about 7% on the day. Management said it is prioritizing revenue growth over near-term profitability, guided to rising H2 2026 spending on commercial expansion, and reported a quarterly cash burn of about $1.1M with cash of $8.3M as of June 30.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced additional medical policy coverage for its PENFS/IB-Stim therapy, adding over 500,000 newly covered lives via expanded access for Mid-Atlantic region beneficiaries. The move continues the reimbursement build-out that followed the Category I CPT code taking effect January 1, 2026.

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis confirmed it would report Q2 2026 results before market open on August 11, 2026, with a management conference call at 9:00am ET led by CEO Brian Carrico and CFO Tim Henrichs.

news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Q2 Stock Dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: NeurAxis's board authorized a second-quarter 2026 dividend on its Series B Preferred Stock, payable in roughly 80,463 shares of common stock on July 29, 2026 to holders of record as of July 21, 2026, rather than in cash.

catalysts.label: VA sales channel staffing
catalysts.detail: Management guided to having about 10 1099 sales representatives in the field targeting the Veterans Affairs market by September 15, 2026, following the VA Federal Supply Schedule contract win.

catalysts.label: Additional payer coverage decisions
catalysts.detail: Management said on the Q2 call it is "cautiously optimistic" that ongoing payer negotiations will yield further medical policy coverage decisions for PENFS/IB-Stim in this window, building on the ~500,000-life Mid-Atlantic expansion announced August 4.

catalysts.label: Next quarterly earnings report
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis is expected to report Q3 2026 financial results roughly in line with its prior quarterly reporting cadence, though an exact date has not yet been announced.

catalysts.label: Adult functional dyspepsia RCT / indication expansion
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis is funding a multisite randomized controlled trial of PENFS in adult functional dyspepsia to generate evidence for future adult medical policy coverage, following the October 2025 FDA clearance in that population; no confirmed readout date has been disclosed.

pulse: NeurAxis just posted a record Q2 2026 with revenue up 116% year-over-year to roughly $1.9M, driven by the Category I CPT code for PENFS that took effect in January 2026 and steadily expanding payer coverage (most recently a Mid-Atlantic policy adding 500,000+ covered lives on August 4), but a wider-than-expected per-share loss sent the stock down about 7% on report day. The company ended the quarter with $8.3M in cash and a quarterly burn near $1.1M, remains unprofitable as it scales commercial infrastructure, and is now building a dedicated Veterans Affairs sales channel expected to be staffed by mid-September 2026. Near-term catalysts center on further payer coverage wins, VA channel ramp, and the next quarterly print rather than any pending FDA decision.
